title: Separate CliRunner streams without losing terminal order
description: Make CliRunner expose stable stdout and stderr streams plus correctly interleaved terminal output.
prompt: Update `CliRunner` so `Result.stdout` always contains only stdout, `Result.stderr` always contains only stderr, and `Result.output` preserves the natural terminal interleaving of both streams. Remove the `mix_stderr` switch rather than keeping two result contracts. Keep the change focused on the runner, its tests, and its change note.
